Protein network clusters and pathways enriched by differentially expressed genes in G2 female white adipose tissue. Red: Insulin signaling pathway; Purple: Response to insulin; Blue: Response to glucose. (Asterisks mark genes that contained differentially methylated CpG sites, see Table 5B)
